display_long_description:
This is the free demo of Lone Link: the first 12 waves of the full game, with three giant bosses. Love it? The full game has 50 waves, a final flagship and an Endless mode.

Lone Link is a VR arcade shooter in the spirit of classic vertical space shooters.

Your ship follows your hand. Move it to dodge the swarm, push it forward and pull it back to dive into the fight or retreat, and let the auto-cannon do the shooting.

• Two ways to play: ARCADE (your ship takes the hits) and FITNESS (the bullets are aimed at YOU - dodge with your whole body)
• Three difficulties that change how weapons are collected and upgraded
• Special weapon chips: homing missiles, laser beam, energy wave, reflector shield and a time-slowing field - catch the same chip again to upgrade it and trigger a powerful bonus
• Power-ups: weapon levels, shields, rapid fire, extra lives and screen-clearing bombs
• Elite enemies, asteroid fields and giant bosses
• Left-handed option, local high scores for each mode, original synth-rock soundtrack

Stand or sit, stay in the middle of your play space and have fun.
